title: Summer 2026 Spotlights
intro: Where Pi Omega brothers spent their summer, in their own words.

spotlights.name: Venya
spotlights.quote: I interned at Microsoft on the XBOX Devices team, working on new electronic features for controllers!

spotlights.name: Siddharth K.
spotlights.quote: I worked on automating a test equipment usage within a test engineering environment as a Software Engineer.

spotlights.name: Maria
spotlights.quote: This summer, I gained hands on experience across the full audit process while building skills in GL reconciliation and SOX testing. More than anything, I learned the value of taking ownership and asking questions.

spotlights.name: Aarna
spotlights.quote: This summer, I interned in Las Vegas as a Financial Analyst at an airline company!

spotlights.name: Kylie
spotlights.quote: This summer, I got to brainstorm and develop new tools and supplies to create 3D printed prototypes alongside mechanical engineers. I also got to dive into market research and design packaging with commercialization in mind.

spotlights.name: Siya
spotlights.quote: This summer, I interned on the Data Ingestion team at Snapchat in Palo Alto, California.
